title: Characteristic-zero polymatroid-general Schubert orbit stratification
author: Crowley, Colin; Simpson, Connor; Wang, Botong
work: Combinatorial flats and Schubert varieties of subspace arrangements

primary_locator.required_new_core: exact polymatroid-generality and compactification/action/orbit construction, Chow-support coefficients and recursive subspace/truncation geometry source1085--1461

difficulty_reason: The proof constructs Schubert varieties of polymatroid-general subspaces and identifies their orbit intersections, dimensions and affine strata with combinatorial flats. Section 4 proves the orbit closure and paving statements through inductive subspace geometry, retaining the genericity assumptions rather than assuming the stratification.
